answer.book: A Latin academic theological disputation printed at Bremen in 1667 on clerical celibacy, built as numbered theses and antitheses with observation sections, framed by a dedication and commendatory verses.

entries.title: Disputatio theologica de coelibatu, ut vocant, clericorum
Thesis I. Contrahere matrimonium verbi divini ministris, liberum est.
Thesis II. Ut laicis sic clericis licet transire ad secundas nuptias.
In honorem Politissimi ac literatissimi Dn. Defendentis.
